source_name: Temenos customer stories / press releases
why_relevant: Temenos T24 is reported as Stopanska Banka's core (third-party technographics). Temenos' own customer-story and news library is where a corroborating named reference or go-live announcement would live, and where other SEE reference banks can be mined for comparables.

source_name: Oracle Financial Services customer references (FLEXCUBE, Mantas/AML)
why_relevant: Oracle Mantas AML is reported in use at a leading MK bank; Oracle publishes customer references and IDC MarketScape excerpts that can confirm regional footprint and name competing AML/core suppliers.

source_name: LinkedIn company pages of vendors selling into MK (Payten, CaSys, Nextsense, Netcetera, Printec, ASEE Macedonia)
why_relevant: Vendors announce MK bank go-lives, joint events and hiring for named bank projects on LinkedIn far earlier and more often than on their websites; MK-locale pages post in Macedonian and name counterparties.

source_name: Duna (Duna Computers) — Macedonian integrator, ULTIMA product and corporate project references
why_relevant: Long-established MK integrator with corporate/enterprise project references and mobile/document-management solutions; a plausible sub-supplier or channel partner in bank projects, and a route to named local references.

source_name: Edusoft (Skopje) — software house serving finance/insurance
why_relevant: Skopje software firm (est. 1990) self-describing finance and insurance application experience; candidate supplier of niche bank back-office systems. Low-yield individually but part of the local vendor census this cell must enumerate.

source_name: Aspekt (aspekt.mk) — MK core banking / leasing vendor, Customers & success stories
why_relevant: Skopje-based software company with ~30 years in core banking, core leasing, payments, digital banking. Publishes a dedicated customers page and named case studies (Oxus Kyrgyzstan, AFK Kosovo, PAMF Madagascar, FINCA Azerbaijan, Macedonian Post supported by Halkbank AD Skopje). It is both a competitor to foreign vendors and a route by which MK/regional FIs are named publicly.

source_name: G+D Netcetera — references / case-study library (Skopje delivery centre)
why_relevant: Netcetera has a large Skopje engineering operation and is the dominant 3-D Secure / digital-payments vendor in the region. Its references library includes a Halkbank (North Macedonia) white-label wallet case, i.e. a directly named MK bank end-customer, alongside the wider EU payments reference set that reveals its competitive footprint.

source_name: ASEE / Asseco SEE Macedonia (АСЕЕ, former АССЕКО СЕЕ)
why_relevant: The largest regional banking-software integrator with a Skopje entity; listed under 'Електронско банкарство' in the MK business directory. Supplies e-banking/mobile banking (e.g. NLB mKlik Makedonija app is built on Asseco's jimba stack per its Android package id hr.asseco.android.jimba.tutunskamk) and worked with the Development Bank of North Macedonia on digitalisation. Direct competitor and a channel through which foreign products reach MK banks. NOTE: the asee.mk domain is my best inference of the current corporate URL after the ASSECO SEE→ASEE rebrand and is NOT verified.

source_name: Zlatna Kniga / zk.mk — MK business directory, 'Електронско банкарство' category (Skopje)
why_relevant: Highest-yield pointer found in this cell: a Macedonian-language directory category that co-lists banks AND their technology suppliers. Fetched listing named АСЕЕ, Некстсенс, Мелон Солушнс, Ултра, Ентаер лоџик ДИТ, Западна Унија/УФС alongside Komercijalna, NLB, Stopanska, ProCredit, Halkbank, CKB, Uni Banka, TTK, Silk Road. Adjacent categories (Компјутерски софтвер - развој, Банкомати) extend the actor map.

source_name: MASIT — Chamber of ICT, member directory (Здружение МАСИТ)
why_relevant: The MK ICT chamber publishes per-member profile pages (e.g. /members-mk/бцс/, /en/members-en/accent/) describing each company's services and sector focus. This is the canonical enumeration of the local integrator/software-house population from which the finance-serving subset can be filtered, and it is bilingual (mk /members-mk/, en /members-en/).

source_name: Economic Chamber of North Macedonia — ICT Association member list (mchamber.mk)
why_relevant: The second, independent enumeration of MK ICT companies plus the named individuals representing them (e.g. Александар Пајковски of ДУНА, and Ултра among members). Useful for actor mapping and for identifying the executives who front vendor–bank relationships.

source_name: SmartPortal.mk — MK business/tech portal, vendor press releases
why_relevant: Publishes MK vendor announcements with bank context — e.g. the first 'Pay by link' service in Macedonia attributed to CaSys, and ASSECO SEE's ISO 9001 track record. Complements it.mk for local-integrator PR coverage.

source_name: Melon Solutions (Мелон Солушнс) — Skopje, e-banking / banking systems
why_relevant: Directory-confirmed Skopje supplier categorised under online banking, banking systems, e-business solutions and call centres — i.e. a local delivery partner in the private-bank channel. Not previously in the seed actor list; needs its own corporate domain resolved.

source_name: Duna (duna.mk) — MK hardware/software house, fiscal & retail systems
why_relevant: Long-established Skopje company (ДУНА КОМПЈУТЕРИ ДОО) in fiscal cash registers, retail software (Spinaker → Vector platform), billing services, and large public-sector integration projects. Relevant to the payments-acceptance/POS side of the channel rather than core banking; its case pages name end-customers.

source_name: Semos (Семос ДОО Скопје) — custom software, system integration, IT consulting
why_relevant: Named seed actor; a 1995-founded Skopje integrator with 200+ recurring clients across the MK and regional economy, Microsoft/.NET-SQL Server oriented, plus the Semos Education arm (semosedu.mk) whose corporate training client list indirectly reveals which banks buy which technology stacks.

source_name: Edusoft (edusoft.com.mk) — Skopje software house, finance & insurance vertical
why_relevant: Named seed actor. Founded 1990, ISO 9001 / 20000 / 27001 certified, explicitly claims software services for the finance and insurance industries plus ERP; bilingual site (mk product pages, /about-us in en). Its sector pages are the place where finance-vertical references and partner badges would appear.

source_name: Seavus (Скопје) — customer stories, incl. FeaturedCustomers profile
why_relevant: Named seed actor. Skopje-rooted, Swedish-owned software house with an explicit banking/finance vertical (Erste Bank, Banca Intesa cited in profiles) and a Salesforce consulting-partner listing. Third-party aggregators (FeaturedCustomers, AppExchange) expose its case-study set and partner tier without relying on its own marketing site.

source_name: Exclusive Networks Adriatics — distributor partnership announcements
why_relevant: Value-added distributors publish new-partnership notices that reveal which MK software houses have joined which regional reseller channel and for which product lines — the distribution layer between foreign vendors and MK banks that neither party advertises directly.

source_name: App-store publisher metadata for MK bank mobile apps (Google Play / App Store)
why_relevant: Android package identifiers and iOS publisher fields leak the actual software supplier behind a bank's app — e.g. NLB mKlik Makedonija ships under 'hr.asseco.android.jimba.*', attributing it to Asseco's jimba mobile-banking product. A cheap, high-signal way to map every MK bank's digital-channel vendor without any vendor cooperation.

source_name: CompanyWall MK / Club200 / ABV.mk — MK company financial & registry profiles
why_relevant: Registry-derived profiles (legal name, activity code, revenue band, headcount, credit rating) for МК integrators — e.g. СЕМОС ДОО Скопје (34 employees, A+ rating 2025), КаСис АД Скопје, ДУНА КОМПЈУТЕРИ ДОО. Lets you size each local channel player and separate real integrators from shell resellers.

source_name: INREKOM study 'Електронско банкарство: Дигитална трансформација во Македонија' (PDF)
why_relevant: A Macedonian-language sector study of e-banking digital transformation that recurs as a top result for both vendor and bank queries; the kind of document that names platforms, suppliers and adoption state per bank. Baseline (2020) rather than current, so useful as a historical anchor for vendor incumbency.

source_name: Interworks (Битола) — MK software house profile via Inovativnost.mk
why_relevant: Extends the actor map beyond Skopje: Interworks is a Bitola-based MK company delivering to large international business clients. Inovativnost.mk profiles MK tech firms in Macedonian and is a useful discovery channel for second-tier integrators that might carry finance references.

source_name: TechBehemoths / The Manifest / Clutch-style MK IT company listings
why_relevant: English-language service-provider marketplaces enumerate MK IT companies with self-declared industry focus (financial services), team size and sometimes client names — a fast way to widen the integrator long-list and to see how MK firms position themselves to foreign buyers. Self-reported, so credibility is limited.

source_name: LinkedIn company pages (mk.linkedin.com) for MK finance-serving integrators
why_relevant: MK integrators announce go-lives, partner-tier upgrades and bank wins on LinkedIn far earlier and more explicitly than on their websites; employee job titles also reveal which bank projects and which foreign product stacks a firm staffs. Applies to Nextsense, Netcetera, Seavus, Edusoft, Semos, ASEE.

source_name: Централен регистар на РСМ (CRM RSM) — official portal
why_relevant: Statutory business registry of North Macedonia (Трговски регистар, Регистар на други правни лица, Регистар на годишни сметки, Регистар на вистински сопственици). Registration is legally compulsory, so every local payments/banking vendor, integrator, PSP and every MK entity or branch of a foreign vendor must appear here. Root node for the whole cell.

source_name: CRM — Основен профил на регистриран субјект (free basic company profile service)
why_relevant: Publishes the core identifying fields per entity — ЕМБС, ЕДБ, full/short name, founding date, legal form, legal status, address, primary activity (НКД), size — including inactive, bankrupt and liquidating entities. This is the cheapest reliable way to confirm that a payments vendor actually has an MK legal presence and when it was created.

source_name: CRM — Дистрибутивен систем (Distribution System, bulk/commercial data orders)
why_relevant: The registry's paid data-distribution channel: structured extracts and lists of entities (filterable by activity code, status, size) rather than one-off lookups. This is the mechanism that would allow systematic screening of e.g. НКД 62.01/62.09/66.19/64.99 populations for vendor/competitor mapping.
